title: iOS and macOS 26.6 arrive today, paving the way for iOS and macOS 27
summary: Apple has released iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS 26.6. Apple also rolled out macOS 14.8.8 and macOS 15.7.8 for older devices, also focused on security fixes.
